metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal item cosine + 1)/2, excluding padding and zero vectors, at most 2048 seeded samples. Values near .5 indicate mean cosine near zero; this is anisotropy evidence, not a recommendation-diversity measurement. Null with fewer than two nonzero samples.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-loader-negative score at aligned original training positions, with sequence, positive and negative all nonzero. Scale dependent; not fixed-candidate ranking performance.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank lower tenth percentile of valid loader margins; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid loader margins strictly below zero; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid loader margins below 0.5; scale dependent; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_valid_positions: Number of valid loader positions from at most ten batches. No user identity is inferred from loader rows.

sequence_interventions.scope: Training-prefix diagnostics only, not host validation or causal intent estimates. No review, rating, category metadata or simulator traits are used. No training or inference architecture is changed.
sequence_interventions.panel: At most 20 identified users per supplied view, chosen by SHA256(seed 42, category, string user ID); up to five latest observed transitions per user. h[:j] predicts h[j], truncated to the encoder maximum length. The complete deterministic manifest is returned for retention and comparison across trials; inputs and protocol must remain fixed.
sequence_interventions.candidates: Target first plus up to 99 unique uniformly sampled catalog negatives, excluding every known training-history item. A repeated target remains an explicit positive exception. Candidates depend only on identified example and seed 42, and are reused across interventions and controls. No held-out histories are consulted.
sequence_interventions.protocol: Independent nonempty prefixes are right aligned and scored at L-1 through view.log2feats and view.predict_score. Loader margins instead use original training positions. Deletions repack survivors and change absolute positions. Causal and padding behavior is inherited from the actual encoder; internal holes are never introduced.
sequence_interventions.rank_delta: Perturbed minus baseline one-based target rank; positive means worse. Rank orders by descending score then ascending item ID, including ties.
sequence_interventions.win_rate_delta: Perturbed minus baseline fraction of negative candidates ranked below the target using the same tie rule; null without negatives.
sequence_interventions.top10_overlap: Intersection of baseline and perturbed top min(10,candidate_count) sets divided by min(10,candidate_count).
sequence_interventions.interventions: Recent deletes the latest max(1,floor(.2*n)) events. Repeated support deletes all occurrences of item IDs appearing at least twice in the observed truncated prefix, independently of target. Intersection, exclusive sets and union are measured separately, never added. Older shuffle permutes all but the latest event and preserves length and multiset. Empty/unchanged interventions abstain with reasons.
sequence_interventions.controls: Up to ten distinct deterministic deletion masks matched exactly on removal count, contiguous-versus-noncontiguous structure and multiset of (five recency bins, floor(log2(training item count))) strata. All contiguous placements or 256 random noncontiguous proposals are searched. No matching relaxation. Returned masks, distinct counts, duplicate proposals and unfilled counts expose coverage; no alternatives means unidentified content-versus-position contrast.
sequence_interventions.target_minus_control_rank_delta: Targeted rank delta minus the mean matched-control rank delta for the same example. Null without controls. Control standard deviation uses population normalization and may be zero with one control; consult distinct-controls-used counts.
sequence_interventions.aggregation: Average defined prefix statistics within identified users, then average users equally in the supplied category. Coverage and users defined per statistic accompany results. A four-category macro requires all four identified category statistics; this single-view probe returns null. Repeat-event counts sum across overlapping prefixes and are not distinct interaction counts.
sequence_interventions.limitations: Deletion effects combine content, length, query and absolute-position changes. Explicit position-preserving contrasts are unavailable through this adapter. Shuffle sensitivity alone does not identify older-context utility. Exact repeat absence is unavailable evidence, not absence of semantic interests. Diagnostic effects do not establish improvement in host HR@10; prospective trained comparisons and uncertainty estimates remain unavailable until actually measured. Global RNG states and exposed loader/sampler generators are restored, but private worker or custom iterator state cannot be rewound; use a separate diagnostic loader. The identified-prefix panel and fixed candidates remain independent of loader sampling.

sequence_interventions.macro_unavailable_reason: This probe observes one view; all four identified category results are required

metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal item cosine + 1)/2, excluding padding and zero vectors, at most 2048 seeded samples. Values near .5 indicate mean cosine near zero; this is anisotropy evidence, not a recommendation-diversity measurement. Null with fewer than two nonzero samples.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-loader-negative score at aligned original training positions, with sequence, positive and negative all nonzero. Scale dependent; not fixed-candidate ranking performance.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank lower tenth percentile of valid loader margins; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid loader margins strictly below zero; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid loader margins below 0.5; scale dependent; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_valid_positions: Number of valid loader positions from at most ten batches. No user identity is inferred from loader rows.

sequence_interventions.scope: Training-prefix diagnostics only, not host validation or causal intent estimates. No review, rating, category metadata or simulator traits are used. No training or inference architecture is changed.
sequence_interventions.panel: At most 20 identified users per supplied view, chosen by SHA256(seed 42, category, string user ID); up to five latest observed transitions per user. h[:j] predicts h[j], truncated to the encoder maximum length. The complete deterministic manifest is returned for retention and comparison across trials; inputs and protocol must remain fixed.
sequence_interventions.candidates: Target first plus up to 99 unique uniformly sampled catalog negatives, excluding every known training-history item. A repeated target remains an explicit positive exception. Candidates depend only on identified example and seed 42, and are reused across interventions and controls. No held-out histories are consulted.
sequence_interventions.protocol: Independent nonempty prefixes are right aligned and scored at L-1 through view.log2feats and view.predict_score. Loader margins instead use original training positions. Deletions repack survivors and change absolute positions. Causal and padding behavior is inherited from the actual encoder; internal holes are never introduced.
sequence_interventions.rank_delta: Perturbed minus baseline one-based target rank; positive means worse. Rank orders by descending score then ascending item ID, including ties.
sequence_interventions.win_rate_delta: Perturbed minus baseline fraction of negative candidates ranked below the target using the same tie rule; null without negatives.
sequence_interventions.top10_overlap: Intersection of baseline and perturbed top min(10,candidate_count) sets divided by min(10,candidate_count).
sequence_interventions.interventions: Recent deletes the latest max(1,floor(.2*n)) events. Repeated support deletes all occurrences of item IDs appearing at least twice in the observed truncated prefix, independently of target. Intersection, exclusive sets and union are measured separately, never added. Older shuffle permutes all but the latest event and preserves length and multiset. Empty/unchanged interventions abstain with reasons.
sequence_interventions.controls: Up to ten distinct deterministic deletion masks matched exactly on removal count, contiguous-versus-noncontiguous structure and multiset of (five recency bins, floor(log2(training item count))) strata. All contiguous placements or 256 random noncontiguous proposals are searched. No matching relaxation. Returned masks, distinct counts, duplicate proposals and unfilled counts expose coverage; no alternatives means unidentified content-versus-position contrast.
sequence_interventions.target_minus_control_rank_delta: Targeted rank delta minus the mean matched-control rank delta for the same example. Null without controls. Control standard deviation uses population normalization and may be zero with one control; consult distinct-controls-used counts.
sequence_interventions.aggregation: Average defined prefix statistics within identified users, then average users equally in the supplied category. Coverage and users defined per statistic accompany results. A four-category macro requires all four identified category statistics; this single-view probe returns null. Repeat-event counts sum across overlapping prefixes and are not distinct interaction counts.
sequence_interventions.limitations: Deletion effects combine content, length, query and absolute-position changes. Explicit position-preserving contrasts are unavailable through this adapter. Shuffle sensitivity alone does not identify older-context utility. Exact repeat absence is unavailable evidence, not absence of semantic interests. Diagnostic effects do not establish improvement in host HR@10; prospective trained comparisons and uncertainty estimates remain unavailable until actually measured. Global RNG states and exposed loader/sampler generators are restored, but private worker or custom iterator state cannot be rewound; use a separate diagnostic loader. The identified-prefix panel and fixed candidates remain independent of loader sampling.

sequence_interventions.macro_unavailable_reason: This probe observes one view; all four identified category results are required

metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal item cosine + 1)/2, excluding padding and zero vectors, at most 2048 seeded samples. Values near .5 indicate mean cosine near zero; this is anisotropy evidence, not a recommendation-diversity measurement. Null with fewer than two nonzero samples.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-loader-negative score at aligned original training positions, with sequence, positive and negative all nonzero. Scale dependent; not fixed-candidate ranking performance.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank lower tenth percentile of valid loader margins; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid loader margins strictly below zero; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid loader margins below 0.5; scale dependent; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_valid_positions: Number of valid loader positions from at most ten batches. No user identity is inferred from loader rows.

sequence_interventions.scope: Training-prefix diagnostics only, not host validation or causal intent estimates. No review, rating, category metadata or simulator traits are used. No training or inference architecture is changed.
sequence_interventions.panel: At most 20 identified users per supplied view, chosen by SHA256(seed 42, category, string user ID); up to five latest observed transitions per user. h[:j] predicts h[j], truncated to the encoder maximum length. The complete deterministic manifest is returned for retention and comparison across trials; inputs and protocol must remain fixed.
sequence_interventions.candidates: Target first plus up to 99 unique uniformly sampled catalog negatives, excluding every known training-history item. A repeated target remains an explicit positive exception. Candidates depend only on identified example and seed 42, and are reused across interventions and controls. No held-out histories are consulted.
sequence_interventions.protocol: Independent nonempty prefixes are right aligned and scored at L-1 through view.log2feats and view.predict_score. Loader margins instead use original training positions. Deletions repack survivors and change absolute positions. Causal and padding behavior is inherited from the actual encoder; internal holes are never introduced.
sequence_interventions.rank_delta: Perturbed minus baseline one-based target rank; positive means worse. Rank orders by descending score then ascending item ID, including ties.
sequence_interventions.win_rate_delta: Perturbed minus baseline fraction of negative candidates ranked below the target using the same tie rule; null without negatives.
sequence_interventions.top10_overlap: Intersection of baseline and perturbed top min(10,candidate_count) sets divided by min(10,candidate_count).
sequence_interventions.interventions: Recent deletes the latest max(1,floor(.2*n)) events. Repeated support deletes all occurrences of item IDs appearing at least twice in the observed truncated prefix, independently of target. Intersection, exclusive sets and union are measured separately, never added. Older shuffle permutes all but the latest event and preserves length and multiset. Empty/unchanged interventions abstain with reasons.
sequence_interventions.controls: Up to ten distinct deterministic deletion masks matched exactly on removal count, contiguous-versus-noncontiguous structure and multiset of (five recency bins, floor(log2(training item count))) strata. All contiguous placements or 256 random noncontiguous proposals are searched. No matching relaxation. Returned masks, distinct counts, duplicate proposals and unfilled counts expose coverage; no alternatives means unidentified content-versus-position contrast.
sequence_interventions.target_minus_control_rank_delta: Targeted rank delta minus the mean matched-control rank delta for the same example. Null without controls. Control standard deviation uses population normalization and may be zero with one control; consult distinct-controls-used counts.
sequence_interventions.aggregation: Average defined prefix statistics within identified users, then average users equally in the supplied category. Coverage and users defined per statistic accompany results. A four-category macro requires all four identified category statistics; this single-view probe returns null. Repeat-event counts sum across overlapping prefixes and are not distinct interaction counts.
sequence_interventions.limitations: Deletion effects combine content, length, query and absolute-position changes. Explicit position-preserving contrasts are unavailable through this adapter. Shuffle sensitivity alone does not identify older-context utility. Exact repeat absence is unavailable evidence, not absence of semantic interests. Diagnostic effects do not establish improvement in host HR@10; prospective trained comparisons and uncertainty estimates remain unavailable until actually measured. Global RNG states and exposed loader/sampler generators are restored, but private worker or custom iterator state cannot be rewound; use a separate diagnostic loader. The identified-prefix panel and fixed candidates remain independent of loader sampling.

sequence_interventions.macro_unavailable_reason: This probe observes one view; all four identified category results are required

metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal item cosine + 1)/2, excluding padding and zero vectors, at most 2048 seeded samples. Values near .5 indicate mean cosine near zero; this is anisotropy evidence, not a recommendation-diversity measurement. Null with fewer than two nonzero samples.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-loader-negative score at aligned original training positions, with sequence, positive and negative all nonzero. Scale dependent; not fixed-candidate ranking performance.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank lower tenth percentile of valid loader margins; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid loader margins strictly below zero; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid loader margins below 0.5; scale dependent; null if none.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_valid_positions: Number of valid loader positions from at most ten batches. No user identity is inferred from loader rows.

sequence_interventions.scope: Training-prefix diagnostics only, not host validation or causal intent estimates. No review, rating, category metadata or simulator traits are used. No training or inference architecture is changed.
sequence_interventions.panel: At most 20 identified users per supplied view, chosen by SHA256(seed 42, category, string user ID); up to five latest observed transitions per user. h[:j] predicts h[j], truncated to the encoder maximum length. The complete deterministic manifest is returned for retention and comparison across trials; inputs and protocol must remain fixed.
sequence_interventions.candidates: Target first plus up to 99 unique uniformly sampled catalog negatives, excluding every known training-history item. A repeated target remains an explicit positive exception. Candidates depend only on identified example and seed 42, and are reused across interventions and controls. No held-out histories are consulted.
sequence_interventions.protocol: Independent nonempty prefixes are right aligned and scored at L-1 through view.log2feats and view.predict_score. Loader margins instead use original training positions. Deletions repack survivors and change absolute positions. Causal and padding behavior is inherited from the actual encoder; internal holes are never introduced.
sequence_interventions.rank_delta: Perturbed minus baseline one-based target rank; positive means worse. Rank orders by descending score then ascending item ID, including ties.
sequence_interventions.win_rate_delta: Perturbed minus baseline fraction of negative candidates ranked below the target using the same tie rule; null without negatives.
sequence_interventions.top10_overlap: Intersection of baseline and perturbed top min(10,candidate_count) sets divided by min(10,candidate_count).
sequence_interventions.interventions: Recent deletes the latest max(1,floor(.2*n)) events. Repeated support deletes all occurrences of item IDs appearing at least twice in the observed truncated prefix, independently of target. Intersection, exclusive sets and union are measured separately, never added. Older shuffle permutes all but the latest event and preserves length and multiset. Empty/unchanged interventions abstain with reasons.
sequence_interventions.controls: Up to ten distinct deterministic deletion masks matched exactly on removal count, contiguous-versus-noncontiguous structure and multiset of (five recency bins, floor(log2(training item count))) strata. All contiguous placements or 256 random noncontiguous proposals are searched. No matching relaxation. Returned masks, distinct counts, duplicate proposals and unfilled counts expose coverage; no alternatives means unidentified content-versus-position contrast.
sequence_interventions.target_minus_control_rank_delta: Targeted rank delta minus the mean matched-control rank delta for the same example. Null without controls. Control standard deviation uses population normalization and may be zero with one control; consult distinct-controls-used counts.
sequence_interventions.aggregation: Average defined prefix statistics within identified users, then average users equally in the supplied category. Coverage and users defined per statistic accompany results. A four-category macro requires all four identified category statistics; this single-view probe returns null. Repeat-event counts sum across overlapping prefixes and are not distinct interaction counts.
sequence_interventions.limitations: Deletion effects combine content, length, query and absolute-position changes. Explicit position-preserving contrasts are unavailable through this adapter. Shuffle sensitivity alone does not identify older-context utility. Exact repeat absence is unavailable evidence, not absence of semantic interests. Diagnostic effects do not establish improvement in host HR@10; prospective trained comparisons and uncertainty estimates remain unavailable until actually measured. Global RNG states and exposed loader/sampler generators are restored, but private worker or custom iterator state cannot be rewound; use a separate diagnostic loader. The identified-prefix panel and fixed candidates remain independent of loader sampling.
